coverage: Covered: every systemd timer and service on node 1 (substrate-live, 46 timers) and node 2 (compose2-live, 16 timers, 5 masked+failed). For each: the effective ExecStart after drop-ins, when it last ran, and its journal output over about 3.6 days (the node-1 journal only goes back to 09-25 13:12). Traced what each writes (file, shape, table or gap) and grepped for readers across the non-mitosis /vessels/*/src, /workspace/active-scripts, /usr/local/bin and super-repo scripts. Also checked the gap-store rows filed by timer detectors (live store on node 1, local copy on node 2) and the caller of every script in /workspace/active-scripts (the script-retention rule). Not covered or unverified: the 12-13 rhythm families were not listed one by one. The DB-side readers of coherence-recover demotions and of auto-describe descriptions come from script headers and were not checked in the DB. I did not verify whether any consumer excludes the synthetic executions from learning-liveness-probe and learning-loop-selftest from posteriors or metrics. The masked node-2 detectors were not re-run. No static reader exists for goalHostBehaviorModel, but it could be resolved dynamically by shape. The 9 gap-learning-loop-selftest-* gaps closed together at 09-28T01:27 were noted but not investigated. The node where the service-failure-* gaps came from was not established.

principles: A unit that ran is not a unit that worked: certify liveness by the effect the unit exists to produce (the marker moved, the row was read), never by an HTTP 200, a systemd Result or 'timer active'.
A failing check laundered into success (SuccessExitStatus=0 1, ok:false inside an exit-0 payload) is worse than no check.
Every scheduled output needs a named reader. A file or shape that only its writer references is an archive, not a signal. Grep for readers before adding a timer.
Fix path-root disagreements at the seam, since one variable redefinition (09d9baa6) produced at least seven 'new' bugs that were each patched per site.
A watchdog's stall marker must belong to its own flow. A shared or default marker makes one flow's cadence a function of another's.
A detector that files a gap without an edit_site or machine check just re-detects forever. Refreshing updated_at is not progress.
Masking a failing unit throws the signal away. Fix placement (resolve by shape) instead.
A copy-without-prune deploy step turns every deletion into a fossil that lives in the volume.
Node-local files (metrics, gap store) read through hardcoded paths make every spoke blind by construction.
